note_text: Colonoscopy: Ulcerofungating mass at Rectosigmoid junction, 5.8 cm in size, occupying about 50% of the lumen. Multiple biopsies taken. Impression: Rectosigmoid junction cancer, r/o adenocarcinoma. Biopsy pending.
Rectosigmoid junction, endoscopic biopsy: Adenocarcinoma, NOS, moderately differentiated. Mismatch repair protein IHC: MLH1, MSH2, MSH6 and PMS2 expression intact (pMMR / MSS).

CT abdomen and pelvis (contrast). Wall thickening of the rectosigmoid junction (5.8 cm) with enlarged regional lymph nodes. No distant metastasis in the abdomen and pelvis. Impression: rectosigmoid junction cancer, cT3N1aM0.
CT chest (contrast). No pulmonary metastasis.
Rectal MRI. Tumor lower margin 12.25 cm from anal verge. mrT3, mrN1a. Shortest distance to mesorectal fascia 14.8 mm.
Discharge summary. Anterior resection (laparoscopic, converted to open) on 2023-01-31 for rectosigmoid junction cancer. EBL 299 mL. Postoperative course uneventful. Discharged on POD 8.

Rectosigmoid colon, resection: Adenocarcinoma, NOS, moderately differentiated. Tumor size 4.7 cm, gross type ulcerofungating. Depth of invasion: Subserosa / pericolic fat. Lymphovascular invasion: not identified. Lymph nodes: 1/17 positive. Mismatch repair protein IHC: MLH1, MSH2, MSH6 and PMS2 expression intact (pMMR / MSS). Pathologic stage pT3N1aM0.
